book.name: Roma
book.title: Roma Roma Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Nego nabudi, e Isaraela azaḡaniꞌa ḡabone hideꞌeteꞌe zamahe niduꞌa hina urateꞌohe zu eꞌe veize Badiꞌa mazao kurauꞌohe.
Ze Badiꞌa veize gaue inare huneꞌeteꞌe eḡeꞌa rae fureneꞌohe. Rehano ze ibi duduḡa mene edereꞌe ꞌahine, ꞌouge inare huneꞌohe.
Ze Badiꞌaꞌa vazeꞌe duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa mene ederadu zeḡe inara hina Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa ohonihi rae inariro. Eꞌanoꞌo ze Badiꞌaꞌa zeꞌe duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa mene hegotiro.
Fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa reifine, Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe ibiḡa Kerisoꞌa ḡonabiro.
Vaze Niduꞌa Ḡabone Hidiꞌuma
Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe moneo Moseꞌa ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu ḡabodiꞌuma.”

Rehano fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige raꞌohe, “Ḡa ḡae zamao, 'Iniuꞌa adure itiꞌuma?' rae ago roꞌi.” Ḡoere eꞌe hugaꞌe, Keriso horonifine, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa adure itadu Keriso tutune raha ovaiꞌuma rae raꞌohe.
Ebu zuni ꞌahige raꞌohe, “'Iniuꞌa raha zizuga ovoiꞌuma?' rae ago roꞌi.” Ḡoere eꞌe hugaꞌe, Keriso horonifine, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano Keriso tutune eriꞌuma rae raꞌohe.
Rehano Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige raꞌohe, “Badiꞌa ḡoereꞌe ḡae uhiḡano, ḡae hebeo zu ḡae zamao eꞌe.” Aꞌe fieꞌeteꞌe moneo emeḡeꞌa harameꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa.
Ḡa ḡae hebe hina Iesuꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boro rae furenine, ebu Badiꞌaꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano Iesu bare ḡabonirotaꞌaꞌe ḡae zamao mae ḡihinine, ḡaꞌe ḡabone hidiꞌuma.
Vazeꞌa zamazeo fiadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌohe zu hebeze hina zaeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe rae furenadu ḡabone hideꞌohe.
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige raꞌohe, “Iniu ani mazao fiꞌeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene hune mazagaroniꞌuma.”

Badiꞌaꞌa Iuda azaḡa zu Iuda mene azaḡa boꞌaḡano mene inaheꞌohe. Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌe tiba zu aniꞌe vaze niduꞌa mazao Zuhiꞌa Boro. Iniu ani mazao umideꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa mazao Badiꞌaꞌa manohuga boro hune ziniꞌohe.
“Zuhiꞌa Boro mazao umideꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe ḡabone hidiꞌuma.”

Tena Zuhiꞌa Boro mazao mene firoteꞌe azaḡaꞌe nougenouge ani mazao umidiꞌuma? Ebu Zuhiꞌa Boro moneo mene igiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa nougenouge ani mazao fiꞌuma? Haramoziniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa oꞌoꞌa reine, ze nougenouge igiꞌuma?
Badiꞌaꞌa vaze mene tuḡuzine, ze nougenouge haramiꞌuma? Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Hari manoḡa harame ragaveꞌeteꞌe azaḡa odaꞌe manoḡa tauḡi!”
Rehano Isaraela azaḡa boꞌaḡano mene vaze niduꞌaꞌe hari manoḡa mae ḡihiniro. Isaiaꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, vazeni ꞌahoga zuni emeḡe haramo ḡoeꞌa mene mae ḡihiniro!”
Eꞌanoꞌo fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe ḡoere igiꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo zu igiꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe Keriso moneo harameꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo areꞌohe.
Rehano e ḡadimuꞌohe, Isaraela azaḡaꞌe hari manoḡa mene igirohe? Hube hune ze igiro. Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Harameꞌeteꞌe azaḡa agoꞌe haba niduꞌa oname hauḡiro,
ebu ḡoerezeꞌe bororu onamo haba ḡonaga.”

content: E bare ḡadimuꞌohe, Isaraela azaḡaꞌe hari manoḡa mene faine ederirohe? Ze ederiro, rehano mene mae ḡihiniro. Eꞌe moneo Badiꞌaꞌa ibite Moseonoꞌo ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Eḡeꞌa eḡe none mene azaḡa zamazeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, zae zama ahiahiniꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa kauriḡa azaḡa zamazeꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, zae zama mae ḡuginiꞌuma.”

content: Ebu Isaiaꞌa mene rihauꞌenaꞌa, ꞌahige riḡa ḡoeriro,

content.text: “Badiꞌaꞌa raenaꞌa, 'Eḡe mene vaḡiroteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa eḡe hidiro,
ebu eḡe mazao mene umidiroteꞌe azaḡa mazao e eḡeꞌa bare fureraro.'”

content: Badiꞌaꞌa Isaraela azaḡa moneo ḡoerirotaꞌaꞌe Isaiaꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro,

content.text: “Eḡe mene hegoteꞌeteꞌe zu agirohiꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazao
